top.title: Israel intensifica ataques em Gaza e mata 3º chefe do Hamas em 3 dias
top.summary: Ataques aéreos atribuídos às forças de Israel mataram nove palestinos na Faixa de Gaza nesta quinta-feira (26), segundo o Ministério da Saúde local, controlado pelo grupo terrorista Hamas . Um dos alvos foi Khaled Abu Nada, vice-ministro da Educação do território e integrante do escritório político da facção. Ele teria morrido junto com a mulher em um bombardeio contra um apartamento na região de Deir al-Balah.

articles.title: Hamas chief: Continued Israeli strike in Gaza ‘unacceptable,’ response being weighed
Hamas weighs response after Israel kills 10 people in Gaza
articles.summary: Five Israeli strikes and a shooting overnight and on Thursday killed 10 Palestinians across Gaza, according to officials at Shifa and Al-Aqsa Martyrs hospitals, where the casualties were taken. A strike on a residential apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza killed a man and his wife, the officials said. FRANCE 24's Jennie Shin speaks with journalist Ahmed Dremly, who was in Gaza until six months ago and has extensively covered the humanitarian crisis there.

articles.title: Gaza’s health ministry says 19 Palestinians killed by Israeli attacks in 48 hours
articles.summary: Israeli attacks have killed 19 Palestinians in the past 48 hours in the Gaza Strip, Al Jazeera reported, citing the Ministry of Health. The recent attacks increased the total number of casualties since the so-called ceasefire began in October last year to 1,705. The ministry said a total of 74,772 people have been confirmed killed and 176,298 wounded in Gaza since Israel launched its war on 7 October 2023.
